verdict.summary: The change consistently derives waiting, progress, liveness, and timeout behavior from the same declared-advisory complement used by the final verdict, while preserving a fail-closed hold for the only potentially widened empty-gating-set path. The focused tests exercise the real polling loop and cover both directions: pending advisory jobs no longer block a terminal green gating set, while pending/failing gating jobs remain awaited and fail closed; advisory-only pending startup cannot pass; liveness and progress ignore advisory activity. The complete hermetic ci-summary test suite passes (193 tests, 3 skipped). No correctness, security, vacuity, or instruction-injection issue was found in the supplied diff.
